create_configuration_imagegpt: create an ImageGPTConfig instance with default OpenAI ImageGPT model settings
initialize_model_from_config: initialize an ImageGPTModel with random weights from an ImageGPTConfig instance
access_model_configuration: access the configuration of an ImageGPTModel via model.config attribute
configure_attention_scaling: configure ImageGPTConfig with scale_attn_by_inverse_layer_idx to scale attention weights by layer index
set_mixed_precision_attention: set reorder_and_upcast_attn on ImageGPTConfig for mixed precision training with key scaling
